**Calculating Total Effort**

technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage Spring Cloud Stream Kafka / Spring Kafka abstractions for message handling, batch listener configuration, and ACK modes.
Implement request-reply semantics via target Kafka request/reply topics using dedicated CorrelationId headers and dynamic target resolution for 'bindRequestor' and 'bindReplier'.
Use Spring Boot Configuration Properties to support global defaults with per-binding deployment override hierarchies for concurrency and compression settings.
Utilize Java ProcessHandle API and Spring Cloud Task / Executable sub-process wrappers to manage Sqoop process execution, signal interception for stopping jobs, and stdout/stderr stream redirection.
Implement Testcontainers with Apache Kafka for end-to-end acceptance testing within the CI pipeline.
assumptions: The software increment targets Spring Framework 6.x / Java 17+ environments.
Sqoop binaries and appropriate JDBC drivers are available in the target runtime environment for Sqoop execution.
A standard CI platform (e.g., GitHub Actions or GitLab CI) with Docker support is available to run Kafka acceptance tests.

activities.activity_description: Analyze user requirements, specify property bindings hierarchy for Kafka binder settings, design request-reply dynamic binder interfaces, and define Sqoop job execution state management.

activities.activity_name: Kafka Binder Concurrency, Compression & ACK Support (U2, U3)
activities.activity_description: Implement global and per-deployment configuration properties for Kafka concurrency and compression algorithms (gzip, snappy, lz4, zstd), and configure manual/automatic ACK modes for Kafka consumers.

activities.activity_name: Kafka Requestor and Replier Binding Implementation (U4)
activities.activity_description: Develop 'bindRequestor' and 'bindReplier' binder methods to enable asynchronous request-reply messaging over Kafka with dynamic correlation management.
Implement batch listener configurations in the Kafka consumer binding, enabling bulk payload ingestion and batch conversion support.

activities.activity_name: Sqoop Job Stop & Log Streaming Implementation (U6, U7)
activities.activity_description: Implement thread/process interruption mechanism to safely terminate running Sqoop processes, and capture/stream process stdout and stderr output directly to standard loggers.
Implement support for Sqoop incremental import parameters (lastmodified, append modes, check-column, last-value) and state tracking for successive imports.
Develop end-to-end acceptance test suites using Testcontainers for Kafka and integrate them into the automated CI build script.
Perform unit and integration testing across all features, verify edge cases, and write configuration and user documentation.
